purpose: Recover M3-M6 with difficulty-stratified development gates and a single fresh-sensor sealed validation.

visibility.V3: current prefix has no usable pose

cad_ambiguity.A2: continuous axial symmetry or severe self-occlusion

sensor_domain.S1: unseen sensor modality and unseen sample IDs

rules: Difficulty fields may stratify folds, weights, metrics, and guardrails but may not be runtime policy features unless explicitly listed in a stage feature contract.
All rows from one physical-instance track stay in one grouped-CV fold.
Every aggregate is accompanied by per-difficulty support and performance.
A stratum with fewer than 20 development rows is descriptive and cannot independently pass or fail a gate.

allowed_uses: historical comparison after an R1 component is frozen

required: sample IDs absent from development and legacy holdout
manifest and labels sealed before inference
one evaluation invocation after all components and gates are frozen
sealed.preferred: physical-instance tracks also absent from development
sealed.fallback_if_no_new_tracks_exist: Declare sensor-and-observation generalization only; do not claim instance generalization.
sealed.reopen_policy: Any method change after opening the sealed split creates a new protocol version and requires a different untouched split.

r1_execution.dataset_split: XYZ-IBD validation observations absent from all RealSense development artifacts
r1_execution.target_selection: Ten per object by stable hash among input-valid observations whose associated track has at least five input-valid views; no prediction or pose-error outcome is read.
r1_execution.sample_identity: Use a pn modality component so every sealed sample ID is disjoint from RealSense development IDs.
r1_execution.claim_scope: sensor-and-observation generalization only because physical instances may overlap RealSense development

M3-R1.question: Can acquired-prefix features predict the marginal value of additional views better than random allocation?
M3-R1.on_fail: Do not open legacy M3 holdout and do not start M4-R1; revise under a new protocol version or stop.

M4-R1.prerequisite: M3-R1 development gate passes and its output contract is frozen.
M4-R1.question: Does CAD-derived visibility add ranking value beyond camera geometry and acquired-prefix confidence?
M4-R1.evaluation_population: Targets for which the M3-R1 primary nested-OOF policy selects more than one view.
M4-R1.prefix_confidence_role: M3-R1 cross-fitted marginal value controls eligibility; it is not repeated as a constant candidate-ranking feature.
M4-R1.anchor: Frozen M2 best static candidate slot 2; the ranker predicts each other slot's utility difference from this anchor and deviates only when the best predicted difference is at least 0.01 combined-AR.

development_gate.primary: On the M3-R1 continue population, grouped-CV ranking utility gain over both fixed-slot and uniform-random baselines

M4-R1.on_fail: Stop M4-R1 and do not train M6-R1.

M6-R1.prerequisite: The final M3-R1/M4-R1 multi-view output is frozen.
M6-R1.input_rule: Train risk only on the exact frozen multi-view output; no post-risk pose reselection.

allowed: raw FoundationPose score and score margin for acquired views
input mask, depth validity, and predicted-pose geometry
cross-fitted M3-R1 allocation confidence and M4-R1 ranking confidence
two-view score, mask, and transformed-pose disagreement
continuous CAD geometry and visibility signals already available to the frozen M4-R1 acquisition path
forbidden: object ID as a model feature
difficulty or visibility bins as model features
physical-instance, scene, sample, or group IDs as model features
joint-success labels, evaluator pose errors, or oracle quantities
feature_contract.separation: Persist inference features and evaluator labels in different streams before fitting.

M5-R1.dependency: independent of M3-R1, M4-R1, and M6-R1
M5-R1.phase_1: Beat nearest-equivalent baseline on symmetry-aligned synthetic corruption metrics.

phase_1_protocol.design: 4 symmetry classes x 4 motion families x 6 stress families x 8 fresh deterministic replicates
phase_1_protocol.selection: Four outer folds grouped by replicate; each method configuration is selected on the other three replicate folds and evaluated only on the held-out fold.
phase_1_protocol.primary_loss: Per-trajectory mean sqrt((symmetry-aligned translation error / 0.01 m)^2 + (symmetry-aligned rotation error / 5 deg)^2).

M5-R1.phase_2: Replay frozen real pose-predictor sequences with timestamps and observed dropouts.
phase_2_input_gate: timestamps or a predeclared frame-clock mapping
at least five ordered pose-predictor outputs per sequence
missing measurements come from absent/failed observations, not evaluator-selected deletion
ground-truth poses and object symmetry are evaluator-only

phase_2_protocol.source: XYZ-IBD validation RealSense recorded multi-view frame sequences
phase_2_protocol.clock: Source metadata has no hardware timestamp; map the sorted common-frame ordinal to 20 Hz before inference and freeze that mapping.
phase_2_protocol.observation_available: Visible input mask area is at least 0.001 of the 1280x720 image and valid-depth ratio inside that mask is at least 0.5; otherwise the frame is an observed missing measurement.
phase_2_protocol.sequence_selection: For each object, choose the associated physical track whose available-observation count is closest to that object's median, tie-breaking by track ID. Selection may use mask/depth support but no predictor or pose-error outcome.
phase_2_protocol.claim_boundary: Real recorded-frame replay with a nominal frame clock; not a hardware-timestamp or unseen-sensor claim.

development_gate.primary: paired symmetry-aligned trajectory loss improvement over nearest

execution_order: M5-R1 real replay if phase 1 passes
single sealed validation after all promoted components are frozen
